description: Occupational exposure, illness, income loss, continued exposure
reason: Closes over existing edges; first link mixed evidence; both return links unmeasured.

description: Clean-fuel affordability, solid fuel, indoor smoke, illness, spending
reason: Closes; affordability and indoor-smoke links measured; health and budget links mixed or unmeasured.

description: Waste services, open burning, exposure, local costs, weaker services
decision: rejected as a loop; burning-to-air and burning-to-exposure kept as edges
reason: No source supports the return link from local costs to waste-service investment.

description: Kiln finance, high-emitting kilns, enforcement, adjustment cost
reason: Closes; return link contested (reported payback of one to two years; most Bihar kilns converted under a mandate).

description: Severe episodes, emergency restrictions, unequal livelihood effects, compliance
decision: accepted as interpretive loop (L7); income-protection chain kept as a chain
reason: Compliance links are interpretations only. The wage-loss to unequal-protection to exposure sequence does not return to restrictions, so it is published as a chain, not a loop.

description: Transport and urban form: distances, vehicle activity, concentrations, impacts
decision: rejected as a loop; exhaust edges kept
reason: No verified return mechanism (travel choice or institutional response) in the sources read.

description: Crop residue: harvest window, burning, restrictions, costs, limited alternatives
decision: partly accepted: regional-coordination loop (L6); farm-cost return link rejected
reason: No source links enforcement costs back to farmers' options; recent declines show the chain can be weakened.

description: Monitoring gaps, unseen exposure, poor prioritisation
reason: Closes; built on a measured mismatch between monitor placement and pollution; not studied end to end.

description: Dust and construction economy: compliance capacity and costs
decision: rejected as a separate loop; covered by L7
reason: No source on construction-sector compliance capacity.
No regionally supported evidence of a local climate or fire feedback in the sources read; black carbon research grants (C170) are not findings.

decision: rejected as a loop; kept as an unequal-protection pathway
reason: Unequal ownership of protection is measured, but it does not feed back into pollution levels.

description: Secondary particles attributed to specific sectors
reason: No source in the register apportions precursor gases to sectors for this region.
The Health Ministry advisory sets out surveillance but no measured demand data were found.

description: School closures cause measurable learning loss
reason: Digital access gaps documented; no learning-loss measurement found.

description: Pollution-related illness causes caregiver income loss (mostly women)
reason: No direct evidence found (consequence pathway P2).

description: Cross-border transport is the dominant source in Delhi
reason: Delhi DSS analysis shows local sources at about 35% and NCR at about 26% in recent winters; neither dominant alone.
